messages.en:
{07 00 00}Do you have a second?{01 00 00 05 00}
Because I was wondering if
you'd take a look at this.
{07 14 00}It's a letter from a friend
of mine, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kas sul on hetk aega?{01 00 00 05 00}
Sest ma mõtlesin, kas sa
vaataksid seda.
{07 14 00}See on kiri mu sõbralt,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Heya{01 07 00}!
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!

A friend of mine sent me a
letter! Here,{07 0b 00} you want to
take a look, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Terekest{01 07 00}!
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!

Üks mu sõber saatis mulle
kirja! Säh,{07 0b 00} kas sa tahad
vaadata, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Tere{01 07 00}!
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!

{07 14 00}Ma tahtsin sulle näidata
seda kirja, mille sain, kui
sul on hetk, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Hello there{01 07 00}!
How's life, {04 1f 00}?

{07 14 00}Hey, if you're not in a
hurry, would you take a
look at this, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Tere seal{01 07 00}!
Kuidas elu, {04 1f 00}?

{07 14 00}Hei, kui sul kiiret pole,
kas sa vaataksid
seda, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 0a 00}Oh, I agree. Totally! In
fact, I thought it was
pretty darned good!
But it's not about the
writing.{01 00 00 05 00} It's about the
feelings behind the words.
{07 19 00}All a good letter has to
do is make you feel
special, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}Oh, nõus. Täiesti! Ma
arvasin, et see oli
päris kuradima hea!
Aga asi pole kirjutamises.{01 00 00 05 00}
Asi on tunnetes sõnade
taga.
{07 19 00}Hea kiri peab ainult
panema sind end erilisena
tundma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Really? {01 00 00 0a 00}Wow... {01 01 00}{07 16 00}I guess
everyone sees things
differently, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}I happened to think it was
a very nice letter.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Tõesti? {01 00 00 0a 00}Vau... {01 01 00}{07 16 00}Vist näeb
igaüks asju
erinevalt, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Mina juhtusin arvama, et
see oli väga kena kiri.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I guess you must be pretty
well read, huh,
{04 1f 00}?
{07 16 00}It must be hard to make an
impression on someone
like you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 09 00}That's really sad.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Sa oled vist päris
palju lugenud, mis,
{04 1f 00}?
{07 16 00}Sinusugusele peab olema
raske muljet avaldada,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 09 00}See on tõesti kurb.

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}What do you think, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 14 00}It gave me a serious case
of the warm fuzzies,
personally, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Mida sa arvad, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 14 00}Mul tekkis sellest tõsine
soe ja hägune tunne,
isiklikult, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I thought it was a bit
strange, to be totally
honest.
{07 0d 00}But that doesn't mean I
didn't totally dig it,
though, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}I just kinda wanted
someone else to gawk at it
too, {04 1f 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma arvasin, et see oli
pisut imelik, kui täiesti
aus olla.
{07 0d 00}Aga see ei tähenda, et
see mulle ei meeldinud,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Ma lihtsalt tahtsin, et
keegi teine seda ka
jõllitaks, {04 1f 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0d 00}This letter made me feel
so happy, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}Not because it really made
any sense or anything.
That's not so important.
{07 14 00}What really counts here is
that my friend meant every
single word written here!
messages.et:
{07 0d 00}See kiri tegi mu
nii õnnelikuks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}Mitte sellepärast, et see
oleks olnud eriti mõttekas.
See pole nii tähtis.
{07 14 00}Tähtis on see, et mu sõber
mõtles iga siia kirjutatud
sõna tõsiselt!
